# Packages

  map(., \(x) get_items(legis_period = x, institution = "NR")) %>%

nrow(items_20_28)

## Keep items of interest

```{r}
#| label: define-item-scope
#| code-summary: "Select legislative item types"
items_select <- c("^A$", "RV", "BUA", "GABR", "GABR13", "BRA", "^EBR$") %>%
  paste0(., collapse = "|")

items_scope <- items_20_28 %>%
  filter(str_detect(type_doc, regex(items_select)))

items_scope %>%
  distinct(type_doc_long, type_doc)
```

# Get item details

## Query data

```{r}
#| label: fetch-item-details
#| code-summary: "Fetch item details with stages and cache them"
#| cache: true
#| eval: false
plan(multisession, workers = 4)

item_urls <- items_scope %>%
  pull(item_url)

safe_get_item_details <- safely(get_item_details)

item_details_raw <- item_urls %>%
  future_map(
    \(x) {
      safe_result <- safe_get_item_details(item_url = x, stages = TRUE)
      safe_result$item_url <- x
      safe_result
    },
    .progress = TRUE,
    .options = furrr_options(packages = c("ParlAT", "purrr", "tibble"))
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: load-item-details-cache
#| eval: true
#| include: false
readr::write_rds(
  item_details_raw,
  here::here(
    "posts",
    "2026-06-08-ParlAT-votingPatterns-2",
    "_data",
    "item_details_raw.rds"
  )
)

plan(sequential)

item_details_raw <- readr::read_rds(here::here(
  "posts",
  "2026-06-08-ParlAT-votingPatterns-2",
  "_data",
  "item_details_raw.rds"
))
```

## Prepare stages data

```{r}
#| label: prepare-stages-data
#| code-summary: "Unnest stages, filter vote rows, add reading and vote_text_list columns"
failed_items <- item_details_raw |>
  keep(\(x) !is.null(x$error)) |>
  map(\(x) tibble(item_url = x$item_url, error = conditionMessage(x$error))) |>
  list_rbind()

item_details <- item_details_raw |>
  keep(\(x) is.null(x$error)) |>
  map("result") |>
  list_rbind()

# unnest stages into one row per stage per item
item_stages <- item_details |>
  select(
    item_url,
    legis_period,
    type_doc,
    title,
    item_number,
    status_number,
    status_description,
    stages,
    votes
  ) |>
  filter(map_lgl(stages, \(x) !is.null(x))) |>
  unnest(stages)

# keep only rows that contain vote results, then parse them
item_stages_votes <- item_stages |>
  #filter(item_url == "https://www.parlament.gv.at/gegenstand/XX/A/1145") %>%
  filter(str_detect(phase, regex("NR"))) %>%
  filter(str_detect(
    stage_name,
    regex("Dafür|(wechselnden? Mehrheiten)", ignore_case = T)
  )) %>%
  filter(str_detect(stage_name, "(dritter?|zweiter?) Lesung")) %>%
  mutate(
    reading = case_when(
      str_detect(stage_name, regex("zweite")) &
        str_detect(stage_name, regex("dritte")) ~ "second & third",
      str_detect(stage_name, regex("zweite")) ~ "second",
      str_detect(stage_name, regex("dritte")) ~ "third",
      .default = NULL
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    #check whether vote call was named based; will be dropped
    vote_name = map_lgl(
      votes,
      \(v) {
        if (is.null(v) || !"text" %in% names(v)) {
          return(FALSE)
        }
        any(
          str_detect(v$text, regex("namentlich", ignore_case = TRUE)),
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      }
    )
  )

table(item_stages_votes$vote_name, item_stages_votes$reading)

item_stages_votes %>%
  filter(!vote_name) %>%
  count(reading)

# more third readings than second readings ?
item_stages_votes %>%
  count(reading)

# fn to extract votes (which party voted yes/no)
valid_parties <- c(
  "SPÖ", "ÖVP", "F", "FPÖ", "GRÜNE", "L", "BZÖ", "STRONACH",
  "NEOS", "NEOS-LIF", "F-BZÖ", "JETZT", "PILZ",
  "NEOS/NEOS-LIF", "JETZT/PILZ", "S", "V", "N", "G"
)

extract_vote_tokens <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x) || str_trim(x) == "-") return(character(0))

  x |>
    str_split(",\\s*") |>
    unlist() |>
    str_trim() |>
    str_remove("\\)+$") |>
    str_trim() |>
    discard(\(p) p %in% c("", "-"))
}

extract_vote_token_candidates <- function(vt) {
  vt_norm <- str_replace(
    vt,
    regex("\\.\\s*Dagegen:", ignore_case = TRUE),
    ", dagegen:"
  )
  parts <- str_split(vt_norm, regex(",\\s*dagegen:", ignore_case = TRUE), n = 2)[[1]]
  dafuer_raw <- parts[1] |>
    str_remove(regex("^.*Dafür:\\s*", dotall = TRUE, ignore_case = TRUE))
  dafuer_parts <- str_split(dafuer_raw, regex("\\bbzw\\.?", ignore_case = TRUE))[[1]]
  raw_parts <- if (length(parts) == 2) c(dafuer_parts, parts[2]) else dafuer_parts

  reduce(map(raw_parts, extract_vote_tokens), union)
}

split_vote_parties <- function(x) {
  extract_vote_tokens(x) |>
    keep(\(p) p %in% valid_parties)
}

fn_get_votes <- function(vt) {
  # Classify irregular patterns first (no parseable dafür/dagegen anchor)
  if (str_detect(vt, regex("wechselnde Mehrheiten", ignore_case = TRUE))) {
    return(list(vote_yes = character(0), vote_no = character(0), report_type = "wechselnde"))
  }
  if (str_detect(vt, regex("getrennte Abstimmung", ignore_case = TRUE))) {
    return(list(vote_yes = character(0), vote_no = character(0), report_type = "getrennte"))
  }
  if (str_detect(vt, regex("mehrstimmig", ignore_case = TRUE))) {
    return(list(vote_yes = character(0), vote_no = character(0), report_type = "mehrstimmig"))
  }

  vt_norm <- str_replace(
    vt,
    regex("\\.\\s*Dagegen:", ignore_case = TRUE),
    ", dagegen:"
  )
  parts <- str_split(vt_norm, regex(",\\s*dagegen:", ignore_case = TRUE), n = 2)[[1]]
  dafuer_raw <- parts[1] |>
    str_remove(regex("^.*Dafür:\\s*", dotall = TRUE, ignore_case = TRUE))

  has_dagegen <- length(parts) == 2
  has_bzw     <- str_detect(dafuer_raw, regex("\\bbzw\\.?", ignore_case = TRUE))

  report_type <- case_when(
    has_bzw & has_dagegen  ~ "mixed",
    has_bzw & !has_dagegen ~ "mixed",
    !has_dagegen            ~ "no_dagegen",
    TRUE                    ~ "regular"
  )

  dafuer_parts <- if (has_bzw) {
    str_split(dafuer_raw, regex("\\bbzw\\.?", ignore_case = TRUE))[[1]]
  } else {
    list(dafuer_raw)
  }

  list(
    vote_yes    = reduce(map(dafuer_parts, split_vote_parties), union),
    vote_no     = if (has_dagegen) split_vote_parties(parts[2]) else character(0),
    report_type = report_type
  )
}

#extract votes
item_stages_votes <- item_stages_votes %>%
  filter(!vote_name) %>% #remove votes with name-calls
  mutate(votes_li = map(stage_name, \(x) fn_get_votes(x)))





vote_extraction_check <- item_stages_votes %>%
  filter_out(str_detect(stage_name, regex("wechselnde"))) %>%
  mutate(vote_parties = map(votes_li, \(v) c(v$vote_yes, v$vote_no))) %>%
  select(item_url, legis_period, reading, stage_name, vote_parties) %>%
  unnest(vote_parties) %>%
  mutate(
    party_clean = str_trim(str_extract(vote_parties, "^[^(]+"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!party_clean %in% valid_parties)

vote_uppercase_unknown_check <- item_stages_votes %>%
  mutate(vote_tokens = map(stage_name, extract_vote_token_candidates)) %>%
  select(item_url, legis_period, reading, stage_name, vote_tokens) %>%
  unnest(vote_tokens) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(
    !vote_tokens %in% valid_parties,
    str_detect(vote_tokens, regex("^[[:upper:]ÄÖÜ][[:upper:]ÄÖÜ0-9/-]*$"))
  )

n_distinct(vote_extraction_check$item_url)
n_distinct(item_stages_votes$item_url)

report_type_check <- item_stages_votes %>%
  mutate(report_type = map_chr(votes_li, "report_type")) %>%
  count(report_type)

item_stages_votes <- item_stages_votes %>%
  distinct()

item_stages_votes <- item_stages_votes %>%
  group_by(legis_period, item_url) %>%
  mutate(obs_n = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

deviant <- item_stages_votes %>%
  filter(obs_n != 2) #limit analysis to complete pairs

item_votes_long <- item_stages_votes %>%
  mutate(report_type = map_chr(votes_li, "report_type")) %>%
  filter(report_type %in% c("regular", "no_dagegen")) %>%
  group_by(legis_period, item_url) %>%
  mutate(obs_n = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(obs_n == 2) %>% # limit analysis to complete pairs
  mutate(
    votes_party = map(votes_li, \(v) {
      yes_parties <- v$vote_yes
      no_parties <- v$vote_no

      tibble(
        party = union(yes_parties, no_parties),
        yes = as.integer(party %in% yes_parties),
        no = as.integer(party %in% no_parties)
      )
    })
  ) %>%
  unnest(votes_party)

item_votes_reading_wide <- item_votes_long %>%
  filter(reading %in% c("second", "third")) %>%
  mutate(
    votes_li_raw = map_chr(votes_li, \(x) {
      paste(capture.output(str(x)), collapse = "\n")
    })
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    item_url,
    legis_period,
    type_doc,
    title,
    item_number,
    status_number,
    status_description,
    party
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    stage_name = paste(unique(stage_name), collapse = "\n\n"),
    votes_li_raw = paste(unique(votes_li_raw), collapse = "\n\n")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    item_url,
    legis_period,
    type_doc,
    title,
    item_number,
    status_number,
    status_description,
    party,
    stage_name,
    votes_li_raw,
    reading,
    yes,
    no,
    report_type
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(
      item_url,
      legis_period,
      type_doc,
      title,
      item_number,
      status_number,
      status_description,
      party,
      stage_name,
      votes_li_raw
    ),
    names_from = reading,
    values_from = c(yes, no, report_type),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{reading}",
    values_fill = list(yes = NA, no = NA, report_type = NA_character_)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    flip_pos = ifelse(no_second == 1 & yes_third == 1, TRUE, FALSE),
    flip_neg = ifelse(yes_second == 1 & no_third == 1, TRUE, FALSE)
  )
```
